outputs.headline: False: Hot water with lemon does not destroy coronavirus
outputs.summary: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice does not destroy the coronavirus, as there is no scientific evidence to support this claim.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice destroys the coronavirus.
outputs.what_is_true: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can prevent, treat, or destroy the coronavirus. Medical experts and health organizations have widely debunked this claim.
evidence_against: FactCheck.org states that there is no data to support the claim that lemon juice eliminates the coronavirus.
Snopes.com rated the claim as "False," explaining that while vitamin C is important, it's not scientifically supported for preventing or curing viral infections.
AP News and AFP Fact Check also rated similar claims as "False."
